misleading_number_note: What would be misleading here is assuming this golden set reflects real traffic volume: it is deliberately stratified roughly evenly across intents (pipeline/golden_set.py), NOT the real ~88% out_of_scope-skewed traffic distribution (taxonomy.yaml) -- so the trivial baseline's accuracy here (0.051) is low, not falsely high. On real, naturally-imbalanced traffic the same trivial baseline would score far higher on accuracy while being equally useless. Read accuracy numbers from this report as 'performance on a balanced sample,' not 'performance on real traffic volume.' See REPORT.md section 8.
